description:
What happens when your coding agents can talk to each other?

Kai Hendry and Vincent De Smet try Rex, Superlogical's new terminal, test live whether Claude Code and Codex can message each other, and compare it with Vincent's orchestrator of long-lived Claude Code agents. They then move from Cloudflare API tokens to Tailscale, zero trust and agent identity, and a wild week of security news: Chainguard's PHP embargo break, Brotli, eMudhra, Linux zero-days and the Binance hack.

AI Infrastructure — Episode 47
Recorded 4 November 2026; a brief microphone dropout has been removed.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Kuala Lumpur, EVs and Vietnam's tech scene
02:54 Running tech meetups in Vietnam and beyond
15:09 GLM 5.3 and other models in Claude Code
18:53 Harness lock-in: OpenClaw, ACP and T3 Code
21:32 Rex, Superlogical and Ghostty
25:35 suckless, st and reinventing the terminal
30:26 Rex skills: agents launching agents
37:40 Agents messaging an orchestrator in Claude Code
42:14 Live demo: Claude and Codex talk through Rex
46:40 Agent interfaces, Rex on iOS and portable MCPs
51:34 Cloudflare, API tokens and missing OIDC
54:21 CI startups chase agent sandboxes
56:42 Is Cloudflare ready for the enterprise?
59:46 Egress proxies, Tailscale and zero trust
1:10:03 sso.tax and Chainguard's PHP embargo break
1:16:17 A wild week of exploits: Brotli, eMudhra and Go
1:23:48 Leaky fixes and leaning on managed services
1:29:34 The Binance hack
